findings.title: Disconnected identifiers and arbitrary existing hash falsely certify foreign source adoption
findings.observed: Validated source-B wire + receipt whose span_id is B but source_sha/claim/parameter remain A -> B span used, no binding diagnostic. Explicit nonexistent canonical source_id also -> used.
findings.root_cause: _evaluate_dependency tests ID membership and hash existence independently; never validates receipt→transported span→captured parent→input claim→parameter edges. formula refs prove formula shape, not source lineage.
findings.required_fix: Build source/span/claim/parameter indexes once and validate actual known edges in a shared receipt-resolution step. Match canonical parent source vs RF local source through existing SourceRef/capture mapping; check provided hashes, locator/parser and claim target/material relationship where present. Keep missing-hash leniency/unknown; do not add permission gates. Invalid explicit bindings become unverifiable rather than used. Add different valid input sources, source ID/hash mismatch, wrong locator/material, wrong claim/parameter pairing and wrong run cases.

findings.title: First intact dependency discards other legitimate uses of the same span
findings.observed: Real consume_narrative_input binds same canonical support span to distinct first/0_base_2026 and second/0_base_2027; real run_forecast emits both; observer span cited_by contains only 2026 chain. Diagnostic incorrectly calls dependencies from same receipt multiple receipts.
findings.root_cause: next(first intact) short-circuits per-span aggregation instead of unioning all valid dependency paths.
findings.required_fix: Aggregate/dedupe all valid bound claim/parameter paths into the one canonical span item. Retain diagnostics for each invalid path without losing valid uses. Add same-receipt and separate-receipt multi-year/scenario tests, order reversal invariant and no duplicate span counting.

findings.title: Compressed inputs bypass the explicit byte resource limit
findings.observed: 133-byte .gz passes limit1024 and returns100000 decompressed bytes; gzip.decompress allocates full expansion before validation.
findings.root_cause: Size limit checks compressed stat only, then unbounded decompression. max-items is later and cannot bound JSON/byte parsing.
findings.required_fix: Use bounded streaming reads/decompression with limit+1 for expanded data (and retain compressed physical bound); raise named resource_limit before JSON parsing/wire validation. Add small gzip bomb and truncated/corrupt gzip tests; deterministic exit2 and no partial output. No increased limits.
